title: What happens with AI
heading: What happens when every station gets AI
caption: Every station runs faster, and documents pile up where the work gets checked.

locator.title: The line
locator.label: Where the zoom sits: Review, between AI stations

pile: For example, 28 documents piled up in front of Review
out: Out: no gain for the company
scope: Teams with high AI adoption, 2025. Time saved creating is <spent>re-spent on checking</spent>; the move to review is measured; that the cause lies upstream is <inferred>only inferred</inferred>.

measured-the-load-moves-to-review.header: Measured: the load moves to review
measured-the-load-moves-to-review.description: On teams with high AI adoption, developers completed 21% more tasks and merged 98% more pull requests, while review time rose 91% and pull requests grew 154%; the report finds no significant company-level gain [1].

faros-ai-productivity-paradox-2025.title: Faros AI, The AI Productivity Paradox Report 2025 (23 July 2025)

engineers-say-the-same.description: Google engineers report that the time saved in creating is re-spent on auditing and verifying, and DORA reads this as work moving from authors to reviewers [1].

what-is-measured-and-what-is-inferred.header: What is measured and what is inferred
what-is-measured-and-what-is-inferred.description: The shift to review is measured; the shift to specification is an inference from it, because no source shows unclear specifications limiting AI-sped output. It is correlational, vendor and self-reported data about software teams [1].

faros-ai-productivity-paradox-2025.title: Faros AI, The AI Productivity Paradox Report 2025 (23 July 2025)

every-station-faster.title: Every station faster
every-station-faster.script: So now give every station AI. Each one runs faster, which sounds like good news, but the line was only ever as fast as its slowest station, and that station cannot keep up with what arrives. Studies of software teams show this right now.

moving-bottleneck.title: Moving bottleneck
moving-bottleneck.script: For a long time the slow part was making the thing in the first place, because a person can only make so much in a day, and that pace set the speed of everything after it. AI takes that limit away. The cost did not vanish, it moved to the next station, and it grows there.
